_note: Re-baseline — linux-clang-RELEASE (2026-07-15), Gate B r1 of perf/validator-hot-path-fable (PR #194, Article VIII §2 re-baseline after an intentional perf change). Supersedes the 075 Gate B r1 seed baseline captured BEFORE this PR's five optimizations landed (config-time msg_type-hash hoist out of the Step-1 walk; exact 8KiB/config-time-vector no_tag presence pre-filter over both group stores; exact enum-presence pre-filter in enum_valid; Tier-2 256-bit single-char enum-code mask; footprint-variant vector-backed presence bits). Real fixpp::dict::table_view loaded from the shipped dictionaries/FIX44.xml via dict::XmlLoader -> Dictionary::as_table_view() (NOT support/mock_dict_table.hpp), so enum_valid()'s tag lookup + code-domain fast-path/binary-search + [multi-value] space-tokenization are genuinely exercised. Each fixture is pre-framed + pre-parsed ONCE outside the timed loop; only dictionary_driven_validator::validate() is timed. measured_release_ns_mean_10rep is the mean over 10 --benchmark_repetitions runs; measured_release_ns_single_run is one --benchmark_format=json capture. FINDING: all four cases still exceed the [2b §6.6] <=200 ns ceiling, but by a substantially narrower margin than the pre-optimization baseline (Heartbeat 568->253 ns, Logon 848->309 ns, NewOrderSingle 1214->372 ns, NewOrderSingleMultiValueExecInst 1265->434 ns — roughly 2.2x-3.3x faster per case). The residual gap above ceiling is accepted+scheduled as v1.0 perf row 15c (per CLAUDE.md 075 merge note), NOT a blocker for this PR.
